A projectile is fired during what the US Central Command (CENTCOM) said was a third round of strikes this week against Iran, in this screen grab taken from a handout video released on July 11, 2026.

(photo credit: US CENTRAL COMMAND/HANDOUT VIA REUTERS)

ByREUTERS, [MIRIAM SELA-EITAM](/author/miriam-sela-eitam)

Iran will not fulfill its commitments in the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) until the United States fulfills its side of the deal, Iranian Foreign ​Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said on Monday.

Baghaei added that US pressure has hindered Iran's efforts to reach an agreement with Oman on a joint mechanism to operate the [Strait of Hormuz](https://www.jpost.com/tags/strait-of-hormuz).

The statement comes hours after both sides completed waves of strikes against each other's infrastructure early Monday morning.

In a statement on X/Twitter, US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that American forces completed a [wave of strikes against Iran](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-902288) intended to degrade Iran’s “ability to attack civilian mariners and commercial ships freely transiting the Strait of Hormuz.”
